### Tools

| Tool | What it does | Read-only | Destructive | Posture |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `get_file` | Read file metadata by drive-id and driveItem-id; this does not extract document text. | yes | no | auto |
| `list_children` | List files under a folder driveItem-id; pass top=10 to bound a page. | yes | no | auto |
| `list_versions` | List historical file versions. The contents are not downloaded. | yes | no | auto |
| `get_version` | Read metadata for one version, for example driveItemVersion-id="1.0". | yes | no | auto |
| `list_permissions` | List permissions on a file; results depend on the caller's access. | yes | no | auto |
| `copy_template` | Request an asynchronous copy of a template file into parentReference.id. Accepted is not completion; verify the destination separately. | no | no | ask |
| `rename_file` | Rename a file to body.name, for example "Quarterly-report.docx". | no | no | ask |
| `delete_file` | Delete a file by drive-id and driveItem-id. The default tool posture is deny. | no | yes | deny |
